topic: Choose a volunteering project for the company day

scenario.topic: Choose a volunteering project for the company day
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you when picking our company volunteering project: impact, team bonding, physical activity, or ease of participation?

options.name: Community Garden Planting at Local Park
options.upside: Creates lasting green space and beautifies neighborhood
options.tradeoff: Requires moderate physical work and some gardening skills
options.concern: Some may find outdoor manual labor tiring or uncomfortable
options.best_for: team bonding and visible community impact

options.name: Sorting Donations at Food Bank Warehouse
options.upside: Supports local food insecurity with minimal physical strain
options.tradeoff: Less opportunity for outdoor activity or creative input
options.concern: May feel repetitive or less engaging for some participants
options.best_for: ease of participation and meaningful social impact

options.name: Building Playground Equipment for Elementary School
options.upside: Directly benefits children and involves hands-on teamwork
options.tradeoff: Physically demanding and requires some construction skills
options.concern: Risk of fatigue or injury among less experienced participants

options.name: Hosting Technology Workshop for Seniors
options.upside: Empowers seniors with useful tech skills and social connection
options.tradeoff: Requires preparation and some public speaking comfort
options.concern: May not appeal to those preferring physical or outdoor activities

shared_context: The volunteering day is a single 6-hour session on a weekday.
The budget covers transportation and materials up to $500 total.
Exactly 6 employees will participate in the activity.
